content.text:
This is an overhead photo of one plate of food from a cafeteria.
List every visible food on the plate, at most 20 items. For each item, estimate its weight in grams and its food energy in kilocalories (kcal).
Reply with only one JSON object in exactly this shape, and nothing else:
{"items": [{"name": "<food name>", "grams": <number>, "kcal": <number>}]}
Use an empty list if no food is visible.

{"items": [{"name": "Cooked black lentils", "grams": 110, "kcal": 127}, {"name": "Tofu cubes", "grams": 70, "kcal": 100}, {"name": "Chickpeas", "grams": 70, "kcal": 115}, {"name": "Spinach leaves", "grams": 45, "kcal": 10}, {"name": "Mixed salad greens", "grams": 30, "kcal": 6}, {"name": "Cucumber slices", "grams": 35, "kcal": 5}, {"name": "Red onion slices", "grams": 12, "kcal": 5}, {"name": "Carrot shreds", "grams": 10, "kcal": 4}, {"name": "Pear slice", "grams": 30, "kcal": 17}, {"name": "Red bell pepper pieces", "grams": 8, "kcal": 3}, {"name": "Olive/black beans", "grams": 15, "kcal": 20}, {"name": "Salad dressing/oil", "grams": 10, "kcal": 60}]}
